faqs.question: Do you have parking available on site?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have 4 designated customer parking bays behind the building.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance receive a full refund or free reschedule.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards, UPI, Apple Pay, and direct bank transfers.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate walk-in clients?
faqs.answer: We prioritize advance appointments, though walk-ins are accommodated if slots open up.

faqs.question: How will I receive confirmation of my appointment?
faqs.answer: You receive an instant confirmation text message and calendar invite with full directions.
